The '''Syruss system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strike force was launched against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] in order to [[Liberation of Syruss|liberate]] the system.<ref name="Gamer 3" />
